title: Store Experiment Results
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Store Experiment Results.
learning_objectives: Explain store experiment results using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for store experiment results
Assess failure and operational limits of store experiment results
concepts_covered: A Store is an interchangeable place to save completed experiment reports.
MemoryStore keeps results in process; FileStore serializes results to JSON.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
